column1: # backend module <TAB> paper-id   — FIRST-CUT topical map (which paper discusses this module).
# Editable data, reviewed by hand. Modules absent from this file are ORPHANS (no paper represents them).
# paper-id ∈ internal-apis | energy-ranking | execute | crypto | maintenance | out-of-scope
#   out-of-scope = the module is DELIBERATELY not paper-claimed (operational/growth/infra).
#   A module absent from this file entirely is an ORPHAN (not-yet-triaged) — drive that count to zero.
# Generated/checked by paper/scripts/backend-paper-coverage.py. This is the REVERSE of anchors.tsv
# (anchors.tsv = paper-claim → code; this = code → paper). Topical ≠ anchored: an entry here only
# claims the paper discusses the subsystem, not that a gate-enforced claim anchor exists.
# --- internal-apis: shadow APIs, shared discovery, the route library, capture→resolve→execute ---
# --- energy-ranking: energy-based selection over the route library ---
# --- execute: execute-don't-guess, small-model tool routing / the execute path ---
# --- crypto: signed layer-descending stack — identity, auth, payments, ZK, settlement, economics ---
# --- maintenance: proof of indexing, freshness, bonded accountability, the shared route graph ---
# (routes/telemetry + services/install-telemetry moved to out-of-scope: growth/funnel instrumentation, not proof-of-indexing — Day-8 audit)
# === Day-3 triage: every remaining module sorted after its kind (first-cut, reviewable) ===
# slips fixed to topical (identity/auth/payments → crypto; sessions+caches → internal-apis; webhooks/telemetry → maintenance)
# deliberately out-of-scope: operational / growth / infra (papers should NOT claim these)
